title: Dominic and the Deadline
author: Elodie Lockridge
blurb: Astrid Marchetti, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
